title: 15 · Safe hash index
objective: Compute a non-negative bucket index, even for Integer.MIN_VALUE.
instructions: index(hash, capacity) returns a number in the range [0,capacity).
capacity is always >0. Do not use Math.abs because of MIN_VALUE.
hints: In Java, % on a negative number can still give a negative result.
Math.floorMod handles negative numbers in a way that suits index calculation.
